Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel, forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel through a __distinct joint__ to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the outer panel-extension joint is a hemmed joint, and the inner panel-extension joint includes fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The vehicle door of claim 1 including at least one hinge that is mounted to the common door inner panel, the hinge being positioned to accommodate the door's movement during opening and closing.
